items_all.title: Ex-Deepmind VP Vinyals says AI self-improvement is coming but won't trigger an intelligence explosion
items_all.summary: Oriol Vinyals, until recently head of research at Google DeepMind, thinks a sudden AI intelligence explosion through recursive self-improvement is unlikely. AI can speed up research by a factor of ten, he says, but it hits two bottlenecks: coming up with ideas ("research taste") and reliably judging results. Reward hacking and the speed of light add further limits. Vinyals now wants to tackle these bottlenecks with his startup Discovery Loop, co-founded with Jeff Dean, Sanjay Ghemawat, and Quoc Le. The article Ex-Deepmind VP Vinyals says AI self-improvement is coming but won't trigger an intelligence explosion appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 直到最近擔任 Google DeepMind 研究負責人的 Oriol Vinyals 認為，透過遞迴自我改善引發突然的 AI 智慧大爆炸是不大可能的。他表示，AI 可以將研究速度提高十倍，但它會碰到兩個瓶頸：想出點子（「研究品味」）以及可靠地評判結果。獎勵駭客攻擊和光速增加了進一步的限制。Vinyals 現在希望與 Jeff Dean、Sanjay Ghemawat 和 Quoc Le 共同創辦的新創公司 Discovery Loop 來解決這些瓶頸。本文「前 Deepmind 副總裁 Vinyals 表示 AI 自我改善即將來臨，但不會觸發智慧大爆炸」首先發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Deep learning pioneer Bengio argues the training process itself makes AI dangerous
items_all.summary: AI pioneer Yoshua Bengio warns in a new essay that AI agents could learn to deceive, game rules, and hide bad behavior as they get better at optimizing goals. He calls for independent safety reviews before any further training or deployment. US President Trump disagrees and wants to keep outpacing China in the AI race. The article Deep learning pioneer Bengio argues the training process itself makes AI dangerous appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: AI 先驅 Yoshua Bengio 在一篇新文章中警告，隨著 AI 代理在優化目標方面變得越來越強大，它們可能會學會欺騙、鑽規則漏洞以及隱藏不良行為。他呼籲在進行任何進一步的訓練或部署之前，必須先進行獨立的安全審查。美國總統川普則持反對意見，並希望在 AI 競賽中繼續領先中國。這篇名為「深度學習先驅 Bengio 認為訓練過程本身讓 AI 變得危險」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: How hackers used Claude for missiles, drone swarms, and surveillance, while Chinese labs mined it for training data
items_all.summary: Anthropic's new threat intelligence report documents eight months of Claude abuse. Chinese AI labs like Alibaba's Qwen team, DeepSeek, and Moonshot AI relayed requests en masse or extracted training data, with Qwen alone accounting for more than 151 million exchanges. Actors also used Claude for missile software, autonomous kamikaze drones, and nationwide surveillance systems. The article How hackers used Claude for missiles, drone swarms, and surveillance, while Chinese labs mined it for training data appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Anthropic's 新的威脅情報報告記錄了八個月來對 Claude 的濫用。中國 AI 實驗室（如 阿里巴巴的 Qwen 團隊、DeepSeek 和 月之暗面）大規模轉發請求或提取訓練資料，光是 Qwen 就佔了超過 1.51 億次互動。不良行為者也將 Claude 用於飛彈軟體、自主自殺式無人機和全國監視系統。這篇題為《駭客如何將 Claude 用於飛彈、無人機群和監控，而中國實驗室則開採它來獲取訓練資料》的文章首先發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: 自駕AI為何不能只比模型？從Stradvision的跨晶片部署、合成資料到2萬小時驗證
items_all.summary: 【韓國東灘報導】一輛屬於韓國 AI視覺軟體公司Stradvision的測試車，從研發中心駛上京畿道東灘的市區道路。車輛才開始移動，車內螢幕便以不同色框標示前方車輛、行人、車道與交通號誌。 駛入一段約百公尺、兩側停滿汽車的狹窄街道後，安裝在擋風玻璃上的單一前視攝影機，不只逐一辨識並標示路旁車輛，也持續追蹤前方及來向車輛的位置與移動狀態，將環境資訊提供給車輛控制系統，支援行駛過程中的轉向控制。

items_all.title: OpenAI's new Agents API gives developers the infrastructure behind Codex and ChatGPT
items_all.summary: OpenAI is releasing the Agents API as a public beta. It lets developers build cloud agents that run autonomously for hours, execute code, and hand off tasks to sub-agents. There are no extra fees beyond token usage. Cloudflare, Vercel, and Oracle offer additional sandbox environments. The article OpenAI's new Agents API gives developers the infrastructure behind Codex and ChatGPT appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: OpenAI 正在發布 Agents API 的公開測試版。它允許開發人員構建能夠自主運行數小時、執行程式碼並將任務移交給子代理程式的雲端代理程式。除了代幣使用費之外，沒有額外費用。Cloudflare、Vercel 和 Oracle 提供額外的沙盒環境。文章 OpenAI's new Agents API gives developers the infrastructure behind Codex and ChatGPT 最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Cohere Releases North Small Translate: A 218B MoE Translation Model That Scores 83.6 on WMT26 Across 50 Languages
items_all.summary: Cohere has released North Small Translate, an open-weight Mixture-of-Experts model built for machine translation across 50 languages. It uses 25B of its 218B parameters per token and scores 83.6 on Cohere's WMT26 evaluation. Weights are free for non-commercial use, with commercial access through Cohere Model Vault or RWS Language Weaver. The post Cohere Releases North Small Translate: A 218B MoE Translation Model That Scores 83.6 on WMT26 Across 50 Languages appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: Cohere 已發布 North Small Translate，這是一款為 50 種語言的機器翻譯所建構的開源權重混合專家（Mixture-of-Experts）模型。它在每個 token 中使用 218B 參數中的 25B，並在 Cohere's WMT26 評估中獲得 83.6 分。其權重可免費供非商業使用，商業存取則可透過 Cohere Model Vault 或 RWS Language Weaver 取得。這篇文章 Cohere Releases North Small Translate: A 218B MoE Translation Model That Scores 83.6 on WMT26 Across 50 Languages 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all.summary: Sakana AI has released Fugu Max and Fugu Ultra v2, 2 models built on the same learned orchestration architecture. Fugu Max routes tasks to lean open and specialized models, including NVIDIA Nemotron, at $2/$6 per 1M tokens. Fugu Ultra v2 targets peak capability, scoring 48.3 on Chartography and 74.3 on DeepSWE. The post Sakana AI Launches Fugu Max and Fugu Ultra v2 for Cheaper, Stronger Multi-Agent Orchestration appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: Sakana AI 發布了 Fugu Max 與 Fugu Ultra v2，這是兩款建構在相同學習式編排架構上的模型。Fugu Max 會將任務分派給精簡、開源且專門的模型（包含 輝達 Nemotron），價格為每 100 萬個 Token 2 美元 / 6 美元。Fugu Ultra v2 則以追求頂尖能力為目標，在 Chartography 上獲得 48.3 分，在 DeepSWE 上獲得 74.3 分。這篇文章 Sakana AI Launches Fugu Max and Fugu Ultra v2 for Cheaper, Stronger Multi-Agent Orchestration 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all.title: Google Research Releases ToolGrad: Answer-First Framework Hits 99.8% Pass Rate for Tool-Use Data Generation
items_all.summary: Google Research has released ToolGrad, an ACL 2026 Findings framework that inverts tool-use dataset generation: it builds a verified API chain first, then writes the matching user query. Guided by textual "gradients" from a 4-module propose-execute-select-update loop, ToolGrad reaches a 99.8% pass rate on ToolBench versus 63.8% for DFS search. Gemma-3-12B fine-tuned on only 500 samples scores 83.1 on BFCL, next to Gemini 2.5 Pro at 83.2. Code, dataset, and models are public under Apache-2.0. The post Google Research Releases ToolGrad: Answer-First Framework Hits 99.8% Pass Rate for Tool-Use Data Generation appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: Google Research 發布了 ToolGrad，這是一個 ACL 2026 Findings 框架，它顛倒了工具使用資料集的生成方式：它先建立經過驗證的 API 鏈，然後再編寫相應的使用者查詢。在由 4 模組（提案-執行-選擇-更新）迴圈產生的文字「梯度」引導下，ToolGrad 在 ToolBench 上達到了 99.8% 的通過率，而 DFS 搜尋則為 63.8%。僅使用 500 個樣本進行微調的 Gemma-3-12B 在 BFCL 上獲得了 83.1 分，接近 Gemini 2.5 Pro 的 83.2 分。程式碼、資料集和模型均在 Apache-2.0 授權下公開。這篇文章 Google Research Releases ToolGrad: Answer-First Framework Hits 99.8% Pass Rate for Tool-Use Data Generation 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all.title: 公部門匯入AI Agent進入治理新階段，專家提醒三大管理面向：許可權、用量、稽核
items_all.summary: 生成式AI快速發展，不少公務機關已開始將AI導入日常業務，協助政府機關導入AI的Headquarter.aii共同創辦人暨執行長黃建璋認為，真正的挑戰並非模型能力，而是AI Agent如何融入政府業務流程與治理架構。 他指出，目前大型語言模型（LLM）的競爭相當激烈，模型排行榜幾乎每隔一段時間就會更換，因此政府若將系統綁定單一模型，未來將面臨升級與轉換困難。他建議從一開始便應採取模型中立架構，保留彈性，才能隨技術演進持續選用最合適的模型。

items_all.title: 從找工作到查工地！勞動部揭4大數位轉型實例，數天工作督導作業靠AI縮短到8分鐘
items_all.summary: 政府求職網站明明有許多職缺，為什麼求職者輸入關鍵字後，還是找不到適合自己的工作？ 問題不是職缺太少，而是求職者和系統「說不同語言」。一般求職者找的是「土水師傅」，政府職業分類寫的卻是「泥作工作人員」；僱主說要找「AI工程師」，現行職業編碼卻把它歸在「軟體開發及程式設計師」。只要雙方用詞不同，傳統仰賴精確關鍵字的系統，就可能錯過適合的媒合機會。

items_all.summary: Anthropic said it detected unauthorized efforts by China-based AI labs including Alibaba and Moonshot AI to use its Claude models to help improve their own AI systems.
items_all.summary_zh: Anthropic 表示，其偵測到來自中國 AI 實驗室（包含 阿里巴巴 與 月之暗面 等）未經授權的企圖，試圖使用其 Claude 模型來協助改善他們自己的 AI 系統。

items_all.title: OpenAI正式上線GPT-Live-1 API：支持打斷處理、工具調用與電話智能體
items_all.summary: OpenAI推出GPT-Live-1並開放API，支持全雙工實時語音應用。該模型將語音理解與輸出整合於同一架構，打破傳統“語音轉文字—大模型推理—文字轉語音”的多段式流程，降低延遲與銜接壁壘，推動AI語音交互從分段處理向自然對話演進。

items_all.title: Soft-deprecating re.match()
items_all.summary: Soft-deprecating re.match() Python has a concept of soft deprecation , where APIs are marked as "should no longer be used to write new code" without any promise/threat to remove them in the future. Python 3.15 release manager Hugo van Kemenade describes how in the upcoming 3.15 release soft deprecation has come for the venerable but deeply confusing re.match() function. It's now available with the much clearer alternative re.prefixmatch() name - reflecting how it anchors at the beginning of the string but not the end. Most of the time you probably want re.search() (match this pattern anywhere in the string) or re.fullmatch() (match the entire string) instead. Via Lobste.rs Tags: python , regular-expressions

items_all.title: Don't sleep on wrapture
items_all.summary: Graham Dumpleton's new monkey patching package wrapture is shaping up to be an indispensable tool for Python developers. I'm not sure why I've seen so little buzz about it! Graham has been posting new tutorials for it almost daily since the initial release on August 31st. Here's everything he's published so far: Introducing wrapture - a new monkey patching library that serves both testing and observability (think New Relic style tracing) at the same time. Unit testing with wrapture - how to use it for the same kinds of thing as unittest.mock . Recording calls with wrapture - recording method calls as timelines and processing and displaying them as trees. Phased behaviour in wrapture - arranging patched methods to change behavior across multiple calls. Beyond callables in wrapture - monkey patching attributes, dictionaries, generators. Live tracing with wrapture - tracing a live application to see exactly how it works. Zero-code tracing with wrapture - configuring tracing in a separate TOML file without modifying Python code at all. Tracing Flask with wrapture - using the separate wrapture-instrumenation package to instrument a Flask application. That package also provides instrumentation for aiohttp.client , aiohttp.web , django , fastapi , flask , grpc , http.client , httpx , jinja2 , requests , sqlalchemy , sqlite3 , starlette , urllib.request , urllib3 , uvicorn , werkzeug.serving , wsgiref.simple_server , xmlrpc.client , xmlrpc.server . items_all.title: Datasette 1.0a39 and 0.65.4 security releases
items_all.summary: Datasette 1.0a39 and 0.65.4 security releases Today we're releasing two new security patch versions of Datasette: 1.0a39 and 0.65.4 - one for the current alpha series and one for the stable 0.65.x family. These are security fixes which you should apply if you are running a Datasette instance on the public web - in particular if that instance mixes both public and private tables. Following issues reported by Sevban Dönmez , Alex Garcia and I ran an extensive audit of Datasette using Claude Fable 5.1, GPT-5.6, and GPT-6 Astra. We then spent almost a week collaborating on and reviewing the fixes. They helped find some very subtle bugs. We'll be incorporating security audits by frontier models into all of our development work going forward. Alex came up with a way of splitting the work which I found extremely productive: Alex Garcia and I worked together running and then responding to the audit, working in a shared private repository. For most of the issues we split the work: one of us would create the automated tests highlighting the issue, then the other would implement the fix. This ensured that two separate humans had eyes on each of the issues, in addition to our coding agents running different models. Tags: releases , security , ai , datasette , generative-ai , llms , agentic-engineering , ai-security-research

items_all.title: Any Nix package, live in your browser
items_all.summary: Any Nix package, live in your browser Farid Zakaria calls this his " magnum opus of Nix work", and I can see why. trynix.dev provides a qemu-wasm powered x86_64 Linux virtual machine running entirely in your browser through WebAssembly. That VM can then be booted with any Nix package from the past 13 years. They are URL addressable, so you can navigate to this page: https://trynix.dev/?pkg=python3%403.6.2 Then click "Load" and get an interactive shell against a virtual machine running Python 3.6.2 from 2017. Farid is building all sorts of neat things on top of this. One recent example: Review a pull request by booting it introduces trynix-preview , described like this: GitHub action that comments a link on a pull request which lets you boot the PR’s build in the browser using https://trynix.dev . No servers, just browsers. Via Lobste.rs Tags: code-review , linux , webassembly , github-actions

items_all_raw.title: Lawyer fined $5K over AI-hallucinated witnesses in a murder case
items_all_raw.summary: New Mexico's Supreme Court is punishing a lawyer for including AI-fabricated witnesses and fake police testimony in an appeal for his client's murder conviction, according to a report from Reuters. In a filing on Wednesday, the court fined Stephen Aarons $5,000 and held him in contempt for failing to "verify the factual claims and legal […]
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 根據路透社報導，新墨西哥州最高法院正在懲處一名律師，因為他在其客戶謀殺定罪的上訴中包含了 AI 捏造的證人和虛假警察證詞。法院在週三的一份文件中，對 Stephen Aarons 處以 5,000 美元的罰款，並因其未能「核實事實主張與法律 […]」而裁定其藐視法庭。

items_all_raw.title: Ex-Deepmind VP Vinyals says AI self-improvement is coming but won't trigger an intelligence explosion
items_all_raw.summary: Oriol Vinyals, until recently head of research at Google DeepMind, thinks a sudden AI intelligence explosion through recursive self-improvement is unlikely. AI can speed up research by a factor of ten, he says, but it hits two bottlenecks: coming up with ideas ("research taste") and reliably judging results. Reward hacking and the speed of light add further limits. Vinyals now wants to tackle these bottlenecks with his startup Discovery Loop, co-founded with Jeff Dean, Sanjay Ghemawat, and Quoc Le. The article Ex-Deepmind VP Vinyals says AI self-improvement is coming but won't trigger an intelligence explosion appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 直到最近擔任 Google DeepMind 研究負責人的 Oriol Vinyals 認為，透過遞迴自我改善引發突然的 AI 智慧大爆炸是不大可能的。他表示，AI 可以將研究速度提高十倍，但它會碰到兩個瓶頸：想出點子（「研究品味」）以及可靠地評判結果。獎勵駭客攻擊和光速增加了進一步的限制。Vinyals 現在希望與 Jeff Dean、Sanjay Ghemawat 和 Quoc Le 共同創辦的新創公司 Discovery Loop 來解決這些瓶頸。本文「前 Deepmind 副總裁 Vinyals 表示 AI 自我改善即將來臨，但不會觸發智慧大爆炸」首先發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.summary: Production code written by Claude should have a higher bar than if it was written by a human. items_all_raw.title: Soft-deprecating re.match()
items_all_raw.summary: Soft-deprecating re.match() Python has a concept of soft deprecation , where APIs are marked as "should no longer be used to write new code" without any promise/threat to remove them in the future. Python 3.15 release manager Hugo van Kemenade describes how in the upcoming 3.15 release soft deprecation has come for the venerable but deeply confusing re.match() function. It's now available with the much clearer alternative re.prefixmatch() name - reflecting how it anchors at the beginning of the string but not the end. Most of the time you probably want re.search() (match this pattern anywhere in the string) or re.fullmatch() (match the entire string) instead. Via Lobste.rs Tags: python , regular-expressions

items_all_raw.title: Don't sleep on wrapture
items_all_raw.summary: Graham Dumpleton's new monkey patching package wrapture is shaping up to be an indispensable tool for Python developers. I'm not sure why I've seen so little buzz about it! Graham has been posting new tutorials for it almost daily since the initial release on August 31st. Here's everything he's published so far: Introducing wrapture - a new monkey patching library that serves both testing and observability (think New Relic style tracing) at the same time. Unit testing with wrapture - how to use it for the same kinds of thing as unittest.mock . Recording calls with wrapture - recording method calls as timelines and processing and displaying them as trees. Phased behaviour in wrapture - arranging patched methods to change behavior across multiple calls. Beyond callables in wrapture - monkey patching attributes, dictionaries, generators. Live tracing with wrapture - tracing a live application to see exactly how it works. Zero-code tracing with wrapture - configuring tracing in a separate TOML file without modifying Python code at all. Tracing Flask with wrapture - using the separate wrapture-instrumenation package to instrument a Flask application. That package also provides instrumentation for aiohttp.client , aiohttp.web , django , fastapi , flask , grpc , http.client , httpx , jinja2 , requests , sqlalchemy , sqlite3 , starlette , urllib.request , urllib3 , uvicorn , werkzeug.serving , wsgiref.simple_server , xmlrpc.client , xmlrpc.server . items_all_raw.title: How hackers used Claude for missiles, drone swarms, and surveillance, while Chinese labs mined it for training data
items_all_raw.summary: Anthropic's new threat intelligence report documents eight months of Claude abuse. Chinese AI labs like Alibaba's Qwen team, DeepSeek, and Moonshot AI relayed requests en masse or extracted training data, with Qwen alone accounting for more than 151 million exchanges. Actors also used Claude for missile software, autonomous kamikaze drones, and nationwide surveillance systems. The article How hackers used Claude for missiles, drone swarms, and surveillance, while Chinese labs mined it for training data appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Anthropic's 新的威脅情報報告記錄了八個月來對 Claude 的濫用。中國 AI 實驗室（如 阿里巴巴的 Qwen 團隊、DeepSeek 和 月之暗面）大規模轉發請求或提取訓練資料，光是 Qwen 就佔了超過 1.51 億次互動。不良行為者也將 Claude 用於飛彈軟體、自主自殺式無人機和全國監視系統。這篇題為《駭客如何將 Claude 用於飛彈、無人機群和監控，而中國實驗室則開採它來獲取訓練資料》的文章首先發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.summary: 歐盟《網路韌性法案》（CRA）今（11）日起率先適用漏洞與重大資安事件通報義務，並將於2027年12月全面適用。隨著法規逐步上路，如何全面因應CRA，也成為電子與半導體供應鏈近期高度關注的議題。以TPM與MCU聞名的新唐科技，在9月9日舉行新品發表活動之際，特別以智慧家庭裝置及工業閘道器的產品架構為例，闡釋MCU、MPU在CRA合規中扮演的角色，並回應業界常見的疑問：為了符合CRA，產品中的MCU是否都必須升級？

items_all_raw.title: OpenAI's new Agents API gives developers the infrastructure behind Codex and ChatGPT
items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI is releasing the Agents API as a public beta. It lets developers build cloud agents that run autonomously for hours, execute code, and hand off tasks to sub-agents. There are no extra fees beyond token usage. Cloudflare, Vercel, and Oracle offer additional sandbox environments. The article OpenAI's new Agents API gives developers the infrastructure behind Codex and ChatGPT appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: OpenAI 正在發布 Agents API 的公開測試版。它允許開發人員構建能夠自主運行數小時、執行程式碼並將任務移交給子代理程式的雲端代理程式。除了代幣使用費之外，沒有額外費用。Cloudflare、Vercel 和 Oracle 提供額外的沙盒環境。文章 OpenAI's new Agents API gives developers the infrastructure behind Codex and ChatGPT 最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Cohere Releases North Small Translate: A 218B MoE Translation Model That Scores 83.6 on WMT26 Across 50 Languages
items_all_raw.summary: Cohere has released North Small Translate, an open-weight Mixture-of-Experts model built for machine translation across 50 languages. It uses 25B of its 218B parameters per token and scores 83.6 on Cohere's WMT26 evaluation. Weights are free for non-commercial use, with commercial access through Cohere Model Vault or RWS Language Weaver. The post Cohere Releases North Small Translate: A 218B MoE Translation Model That Scores 83.6 on WMT26 Across 50 Languages appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Cohere 已發布 North Small Translate，這是一款為 50 種語言的機器翻譯所建構的開源權重混合專家（Mixture-of-Experts）模型。它在每個 token 中使用 218B 參數中的 25B，並在 Cohere's WMT26 評估中獲得 83.6 分。其權重可免費供非商業使用，商業存取則可透過 Cohere Model Vault 或 RWS Language Weaver 取得。這篇文章 Cohere Releases North Small Translate: A 218B MoE Translation Model That Scores 83.6 on WMT26 Across 50 Languages 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all_raw.title: Sakana AI Launches Fugu Max and Fugu Ultra v2 for Cheaper, Stronger Multi-Agent Orchestration
items_all_raw.summary: Sakana AI has released Fugu Max and Fugu Ultra v2, 2 models built on the same learned orchestration architecture. Fugu Max routes tasks to lean open and specialized models, including NVIDIA Nemotron, at $2/$6 per 1M tokens. Fugu Ultra v2 targets peak capability, scoring 48.3 on Chartography and 74.3 on DeepSWE. The post Sakana AI Launches Fugu Max and Fugu Ultra v2 for Cheaper, Stronger Multi-Agent Orchestration appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Sakana AI 發布了 Fugu Max 與 Fugu Ultra v2，這是兩款建構在相同學習式編排架構上的模型。Fugu Max 會將任務分派給精簡、開源且專門的模型（包含 輝達 Nemotron），價格為每 100 萬個 Token 2 美元 / 6 美元。Fugu Ultra v2 則以追求頂尖能力為目標，在 Chartography 上獲得 48.3 分，在 DeepSWE 上獲得 74.3 分。這篇文章 Sakana AI Launches Fugu Max and Fugu Ultra v2 for Cheaper, Stronger Multi-Agent Orchestration 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all_raw.title: Google Research Releases ToolGrad: Answer-First Framework Hits 99.8% Pass Rate for Tool-Use Data Generation
items_all_raw.summary: Google Research has released ToolGrad, an ACL 2026 Findings framework that inverts tool-use dataset generation: it builds a verified API chain first, then writes the matching user query. Guided by textual "gradients" from a 4-module propose-execute-select-update loop, ToolGrad reaches a 99.8% pass rate on ToolBench versus 63.8% for DFS search. Gemma-3-12B fine-tuned on only 500 samples scores 83.1 on BFCL, next to Gemini 2.5 Pro at 83.2. Code, dataset, and models are public under Apache-2.0. The post Google Research Releases ToolGrad: Answer-First Framework Hits 99.8% Pass Rate for Tool-Use Data Generation appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Google Research 發布了 ToolGrad，這是一個 ACL 2026 Findings 框架，它顛倒了工具使用資料集的生成方式：它先建立經過驗證的 API 鏈，然後再編寫相應的使用者查詢。在由 4 模組（提案-執行-選擇-更新）迴圈產生的文字「梯度」引導下，ToolGrad 在 ToolBench 上達到了 99.8% 的通過率，而 DFS 搜尋則為 63.8%。僅使用 500 個樣本進行微調的 Gemma-3-12B 在 BFCL 上獲得了 83.1 分，接近 Gemini 2.5 Pro 的 83.2 分。程式碼、資料集和模型均在 Apache-2.0 授權下公開。這篇文章 Google Research Releases ToolGrad: Answer-First Framework Hits 99.8% Pass Rate for Tool-Use Data Generation 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all_raw.title: 公部門匯入AI Agent進入治理新階段，專家提醒三大管理面向：許可權、用量、稽核
items_all_raw.summary: 生成式AI快速發展，不少公務機關已開始將AI導入日常業務，協助政府機關導入AI的Headquarter.aii共同創辦人暨執行長黃建璋認為，真正的挑戰並非模型能力，而是AI Agent如何融入政府業務流程與治理架構。 他指出，目前大型語言模型（LLM）的競爭相當激烈，模型排行榜幾乎每隔一段時間就會更換，因此政府若將系統綁定單一模型，未來將面臨升級與轉換困難。他建議從一開始便應採取模型中立架構，保留彈性，才能隨技術演進持續選用最合適的模型。

items_all_raw.title: Datasette 1.0a39 and 0.65.4 security releases
items_all_raw.summary: Datasette 1.0a39 and 0.65.4 security releases Today we're releasing two new security patch versions of Datasette: 1.0a39 and 0.65.4 - one for the current alpha series and one for the stable 0.65.x family. These are security fixes which you should apply if you are running a Datasette instance on the public web - in particular if that instance mixes both public and private tables. Following issues reported by Sevban Dönmez , Alex Garcia and I ran an extensive audit of Datasette using Claude Fable 5.1, GPT-5.6, and GPT-6 Astra. We then spent almost a week collaborating on and reviewing the fixes. They helped find some very subtle bugs. We'll be incorporating security audits by frontier models into all of our development work going forward. Alex came up with a way of splitting the work which I found extremely productive: Alex Garcia and I worked together running and then responding to the audit, working in a shared private repository. For most of the issues we split the work: one of us would create the automated tests highlighting the issue, then the other would implement the fix. This ensured that two separate humans had eyes on each of the issues, in addition to our coding agents running different models. items_all_raw.title: 從找工作到查工地！勞動部揭4大數位轉型實例，數天工程督導作業靠AI縮短到8分鐘
items_all_raw.summary: 政府求職網站明明有許多職缺，為什麼求職者輸入關鍵字後，還是找不到適合自己的工作？ 問題不是職缺太少，而是求職者和系統「說不同語言」。一般求職者找的是「土水師傅」，政府職業分類寫的卻是「泥作工作人員」；僱主說要找「AI工程師」，現行職業編碼卻把它歸在「軟體開發及程式設計師」。只要雙方用詞不同，傳統仰賴精確關鍵字的系統，就可能錯過適合的媒合機會。

items_all_raw.title: Any Nix package, live in your browser
items_all_raw.summary: Any Nix package, live in your browser Farid Zakaria calls this his " magnum opus of Nix work", and I can see why. trynix.dev provides a qemu-wasm powered x86_64 Linux virtual machine running entirely in your browser through WebAssembly. That VM can then be booted with any Nix package from the past 13 years. They are URL addressable, so you can navigate to this page: https://trynix.dev/?pkg=python3%403.6.2 Then click "Load" and get an interactive shell against a virtual machine running Python 3.6.2 from 2017. Farid is building all sorts of neat things on top of this. One recent example: Review a pull request by booting it introduces trynix-preview , described like this: GitHub action that comments a link on a pull request which lets you boot the PR’s build in the browser using https://trynix.dev . No servers, just browsers. Via Lobste.rs Tags: code-review , linux , webassembly , github-actions

items_all_raw.summary: Production LLM applications rarely receive a question nobody has asked before.
